style: Tell this as a grounded American family story unfolding around a kitchen table. Mature, conversational, affectionate, and unsentimental, with dry comic timing. Ray is an older Florida man who is confident, specific, and sometimes ridiculous, but never a redneck caricature or a secret folk hero. Linda is practical and quick; Callie is composed and persistent. Differentiate them through rhythm and light inflection only, with no performed accents. Let interruptions and corrections land cleanly. Use a natural, moderately unhurried pace around 165 to 180 words per minute; do not turn reflective passages into an audiobook performance.

postprocess.reason: Bring a measured 140 WPM synthesis to a conversational 146 WPM pace.
